                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n1ea:Tc42,\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Let Total Income be 100%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Remaining income after 20% house rent = 80%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Savings = 30% of remaining (since 70% was spent) ⇒ 30% × 80% = 24%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given, 24% = ₹1,800 ⇒ 1% = 75.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Total Income (100%) = 75 × 100 = ₹7,500.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The correct answer is ₹7,500.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Expenditure on house rent = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Expenditure on household items = 70% of the remaining amount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Total Savings = ₹1,800

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Let the total income of Sanjay be ₹x.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Amount left after house rent = x − 20% of x = 0.80x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Amount spent on household expenses = 70% of 0.80x = 0.56x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Total savings = 0.80x − 0.56x = 0.24x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 0.24x = 1800

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 1800 ÷ 0.24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 180000 ÷ 24 = 7500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Thus, the total income is ₹7,500, which corresponds to Option (3).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The correct answer is ₹7,500.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Successive Percentage Change

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When interest is compounded annually, the interest earned in the 3rd year is simply the interest on the amount at the end of the 2nd year.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rate % = [(Difference between successive amounts) ÷ (Preceding amount)] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rate % = [(6083.50 − 5290) ÷ 5290] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rate % = (793.50 ÷ 5290) × 100 = 15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The correct answer is 15%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Amount after 2 years (A2) = ₹5,290

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Amount after 3 years (A3) = ₹6,083.50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    An = P(1 + R/100)n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ A3 / A2 = [P(1 + R/100)3] / [P(1 + R/100)2]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 6083.50 / 5290 = (1 + R/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 1.15 = 1 + R/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ R/100 = 1.15 − 1 = 0.15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ R = 0.15 × 100 = 15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The correct answer is 15%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Compound Interest for Successive Years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If amounts for two consecutive years (n and n+1) are given, the rate R = [(An+1 − An) ÷ An] × 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Difference between CI and SI

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    For a period of 2 years, the difference between CI and SI is given by D = P × (R/100)2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Half-Yearly Compounding

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If interest is compounded half-yearly, the rate becomes R/2 and the time period becomes 2n.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n20", "hn": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    जब ब्याज वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है, तो तीसरे (3rd) वर्ष में अर्जित ब्याज केवल दूसरे (2nd) वर्ष के अंत में मिश्रधन पर लगने वाला ब्याज होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दर % = [(क्रमिक मिश्रधनों के बीच अंतर) ÷ (पूर्ववर्ती मिश्रधन)] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दर % = [(6083.50 − 5290) ÷ 5290] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दर % = (793.50 ÷ 5290) × 100 = 15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ सही उत्तर 15% है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2 वर्ष बाद मिश्रधन (A2) = ₹5,290

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3 वर्ष बाद मिश्रधन (A3) = ₹6,083.50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    An = P(1 + R/100)n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ A3 / A2 = [P(1 + R/100)3] / [P(1 + R/100)2]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 6083.50 / 5290 = (1 + R/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 1.15 = 1 + R/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ R/100 = 1.15 − 1 = 0.15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ R = 0.15 × 100 = 15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ सही उत्तर 15% है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    क्रमिक वर्षों के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    यदि दो लगातार वर्षों (n और n+1) के लिए मिश्रधन दिए गए हों, तो दर R = [(An+1 − An) ÷ An] × 100 होती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    CI और SI के बीच अंतर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2 वर्ष की अवधि के लिए, CI और SI के बीच का अंतर D = P × (R/100)2 द्वारा दिया जाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    अर्ध-वार्षिक संयोजन

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    यदि ब्याज अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है, तो दर R/2 हो जाती है और समय अवधि 2n हो जाती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    చక్రవడ్డీ ఏటా  లెక్కించబడుతుంది.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    n సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత మొత్తం = P(1 + r) n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇచ్చిన సమాచారం నుండి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    P(1 + r)2 = 5,290

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    P(1 + r)3 = 6,083.50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    రెండు సమీకరణాలను భాగించడం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
